name: Moody
description: This mon has some pretty crazy mood swings, from happy to angrybat the drop of a pin.
effect: At the end of each Round this pokemon receives a random +2 Increase and -1 Reduction to a Stat amongst Strength, Special, Defense, Special Defense, and Dexterity. These Stat Changes may stack with themselves, but are still subject to the standard +/-3 limit for Stat Changes.
